name: Fuyuno Suzushiro
source:
"Would you die with me?"

Participant in the Death Game. Ministry of Health employee. A trainee nurse at the hospital. A fan of the Founder who wants to follow the doctrines, and as a result, is not enthusiastic about the Death Game.

[From [url=https://x.com/SpikeChunsoft_e/status/1947703187898568734/]official Twitter[/url]]

The youngest Fuyuno sister.
